g.text: Candidate patch ff3fb5df · no baseline timing comparison
CPUs 2–6 · powersave · shared host · parser in memory · warm Btrfs files/metadata
3 runs/case · 30 flat samples · 0.3 s warmup · 2 s target
Resolution includes opening, validation and closing sources · load includes descriptor parsing · no logical disk reads.
